items.title: Write a focused resolution execution plan for the three high gaps
items.context: The existing B-3a80 document is a triage and boundary plan. This story should add a concrete next execution plan for two signed-workspace binding gaps plus the Layer4 customerKeyRef future or blocked gap. It must avoid claiming the gaps are already fixed.
items.userSees: A new decision document explains how to resolve the two signed-workspace gaps and the customerKeyRef future/blocked gap without false closure.

happy.desc: Document names all three current gap_analyze high gaps and assigns each to an exact follow-up action.

edge.desc: Document says customerKeyRef remains future/blocked unless a separate Layer4 implementation story provides redaction and Authority receipt evidence.

adversarial.desc: Document forbids claiming F-009 closure, Layer2/Layer4 unlock, productionDone, receiptVerified, or Authority completion from this planning story.

items.title: Update requirements navigation for the new execution plan
items.context: If a new decision document is created, NAV must include it and keep the document count consistent.
items.userSees: NAV lists the new three-high-gap resolution plan and the decision document count remains consistent.

happy.desc: NAV includes a relative link to resolve-gap-analyze-three-high-gaps-execution-plan.md.

edge.desc: NAV decision document count matches the number of decision links after the new document is added.

adversarial.desc: NAV does not remove or overwrite the prior B-3a80 triage plan link.
